lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Highly regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and twelve vertical columns between the pectoral and pelvic fin planes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal spot rows to form a consistent lattice-like grid across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, each characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the superior edge and deep shadow on the inferior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: The first dorsal fin exhibits severe distal truncation with an irregular, jagged, and low-luminance superior margin indicative of major tissue loss. A blue synthetic tag is tethered to the dorsal midline anterior to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A high-saturation blue artificial object is attached via a thin filament to the dorsal region, trailing posterior-ventrally.
